desc: Understand the problem and derive the formula: f(L,R) = number of maximal consecutive runs in the set of distinct values in A[L..R], which equals the count of values v present such that v-1 is not present.
Design an O(N) algorithm using two-pointer merging for each v independently.
Implement the O(N) algorithm in Python: read input, build pos lists, then for each v, compute the count and sum.
Review the provided code for correctness, edge cases (v=1, v-1 absent, empty position lists), and performance, then test it on samples 1, 2, 3 to ensure correct output.
The code produces correct outputs for the samples, and the solution is finalized.
